Round173B.convolution_quotient_intertwining.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace X]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (G : Submodule ℂ H) [CompleteSpace ↥G]
  (μ : Measure X) (T : X → H →L[ℂ] H) (h : X → ℂ) (hinv : ∀ (t : X), ∀ x ∈ G, (T t) x ∈ G) (A : H →L[ℂ] H)
  (hA : ∀ (x : H), A x = ∫ (t : X), h t • (T t) x ∂μ) (hint : ∀ (x : H), Integrable (fun t => h t • (T t) x) μ) :
  ∃ B, ∀ (x : H), B (G.mkQ x) = G.mkQ (A x)

Round173B.projected_convolution_factors.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace X]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (G : Submodule ℂ H) [CompleteSpace ↥G]
  (μ : Measure X) (T : X → H →L[ℂ] H) (h : X → ℂ) (hinv : ∀ (t : X), ∀ x ∈ G, (T t) x ∈ G) (A : H →L[ℂ] H)
  (hA : ∀ (x : H), A x = ∫ (t : X), h t • (T t) x ∂μ) (hint : ∀ (x : H), Integrable (fun t => h t • (T t) x) μ) :
  ∃ B S,
    (∀ (x : H), B (G.mkQ x) = G.mkQ (A x)) ∧
      (∀ (x : H), S (G.mkQ x) = (Round173B.spectralProjection G) x) ∧
        ∀ (x : H), (Round173B.spectralProjection G) (A x) = S (B (G.mkQ x))
